instruction:
Work in AutoCAD and open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\base.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\slider.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\pin.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\cover.dxf. Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.

Import base.dxf, slider.dxf, pin.dxf, and cover.dxf. Draw a slider assembly with base rectangle (0,0)-(180,40), rail CENTER lines y=12 and y=28 from x=10 to x=170, slider rectangle (55,45)-(125,85), pin circle centered at (90,65) radius 8, cover rectangle (45,90)-(135,112), and text ACAD-26. Use OUTLINE for base, slider, and cover rectangles, CENTER for rail lines, HOLE for the pin circle, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
